# WallStreetMojo

> WallStreetMojo is a comprehensive online platform offering professional certifications and courses in financial modeling, accounting, derivatives, alternative investments, and business analytics.

Founded by Dheeraj Vaidya with instructors from top financial institutions like J.P.Morgan and CLSA, WallStreetMojo provides financial education and professional development through online courses, certifications, and enterprise training programs. The platform serves learners globally with expertise in Excel, Power BI, VBA, Python, and advanced financial concepts.

## Key Topics

- Financial Modeling
- Excel
- Power BI
- VBA
- Python
- Accounting
- Derivatives
- Alternative Investments
- Machine Learning
- Professional Certifications
- CFA
- FRM
- Budgeting
- Enterprise Training
- Financial Education

## Core Course Offerings

- [Accounting Courses](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/accounting): Accounting and ratio analysis courses for financial analyst certification
- [Derivatives Courses & Certifications](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/derivatives): Basic and advanced derivatives trading and options-futures certifications
- [Alternative Investments Courses](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/alternative-investments): Private equity, REITs, and hedge funds investment strategy courses
- [Budgeting Courses](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/budgeting): Business budgeting and financial planning analysis courses with Excel
- [AI and Machine Learning Certifications](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/ai-machine-learning): AI, ML, Python, and ChatGPT certifications for financial modeling

## Enterprise & Organization

- [Enterprise Training](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/enterprise): Enterprise training and corporate learning for financial modeling certifications
- [About Us](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/about-us): WallStreetMojo mission, finance courses, and founder Dheeraj Vaidya's vision
- [WallStreetMojo Team](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/wallstreetmojo-team): Qualified instructor team with J.P.Morgan and CLSA finance experience
- [Become an Instructor](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/become-an-instructor): Instructor recruitment and community for financial modeling and course creation
